subject: Cross-functional MAP kickoff + technical introductions
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Martinez <emartinez@starktech.com>, Oliver Grant <ogrant@starktech.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Cross-functional MAP kickoff + technical introductions

Hi Elena / Oliver —

Thanks again for the quick discovery last week. Per our conversation, Id like to kickoff a short mutual action plan (MAP) and introduce the technical leads who will run the evaluation with you. The goal: validate latency/cost profile and integration path on your sample data and agree on success criteria so procurement can move forward to close by early December.

High-level 6-week evaluation sketch (attached: evaluation_plan_6week.xlsx and MAP PDF):
- Week 0 (this week): Kickoff, access provisioning, success criteria sign-off
- Week 1: Baseline run on 1–5k sample records, metrics collection (latency, throughput, token cost)
- Week 2: SE pairing & integration (prefix/KV caching, batching knobs)
- Week 3: Model/quantization recommendation and throughput tuning
- Week 4: Security/compliance checklist and audit log review
- Week 5: Final evaluation, handoff to procurement & production runbook

Primary roles:
- Customer engineering lead: Elena Martinez (StarkTech) — overall owner for sample data and test environment
- Solutions Engineer (Redwood): Soojin Lee — integration, runtime tuning, test harness
- ML Engineer (Redwood): Priyom Das — model selection, metric analysis, quantization guidance

Ask: can you confirm the internal StarkTech stakeholders for data access and procurement cadence? Im proposing a 30-minute kickoff call to align timelines and assign owners: Wed Nov 10, 10:00 AM PT (calendar link below). If that doesnt work, send two alternatives.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_StarkTech_v1.pdf, evaluation_plan_6week.xlsx
Calendar: https://cal.example.com/jw/30m

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber

jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com

Thanks Elena — quick intro from my side.

Im Soojin (Solutions Engineer) and Ill own integration and runtime tuning during the MAP. Quick checklist for the kickoff and for Mike/Platform:
- S3 read-only path for test samples (ideal: 5k records, 100–500 tokens each)
- Temporary API key or role for our test runner (scoped, short TTL)
- Preferred latency SLOs (p50/p95 targets) and any concurrent request expectations
- Any network egress constraints (VPC endpoints / allowlist IPs)

Priyom and I will bring a minimal test harness (dockerized) that runs a baseline model and reports token cost, latency distribution, and a simple quality check (top-k overlap against ground truth if available). If you can share a minimal sample before the call (s3 path or zipped CSV), we can pre-run a baseline overnight and bring numbers to the kickoff.

Forwarding Jonass MAP for reference.

—Soojinn (on behalf of Redwood SEs)
